findings.message: v0.1.1 hotfix acceptance pass — all 12 SPEC acceptance criteria and all 10 tasks T-DSR-01..10 marked done. 4 bugs closed (A resolver / B corrupt-JSON / C probe / D scan+UI gap). 635 unit tests passing (was 595 pre-hotfix; +40 net new).
